faq.title: Sawaal, jawaab
faq.q1: Kya unhe app download karna padega?
faq.a1: Nahi. Ye ek link hai — kisi bhi phone browser mein khulta hai, Instagram aur WhatsApp ke andar bhi.
faq.q2: Pay karne se pehle dekh sakte hain?
faq.a2: Haan — poora gift, free mein. Paise sirf bhejne pe.
faq.a3: Haan. Quick Surprise free hai aur 24 ghante rehta hai. Pasand aaye toh tum ya wo, koi bhi forever kar sakta hai.
faq.q4: Group gift kaise kaam karta hai?
faq.a4: Tumhe ek link milta hai. Sab apna message, photo ya voice note daalte hain — bina sign-up. Reveal time pe sab ek saath khulta hai.
faq.q5: Midnight ke liye schedule kar sakte hain?
faq.a5: Haan, unke timezone mein. Hum usi minute WhatsApp, SMS ya email se link bhejte hain.
faq.q6: Mera gift kaun dekh sakta hai?
faq.a6: Sirf link wale. Link lambe aur unguessable hain, search engines pe nahi aate, aur password bhi laga sakte ho.
faq.a7: YouTube ya Spotify link paste karo, official player se bajega. Hum khud music host nahi karte.
faq.a8: Agar hamari wajah se deliver na ho toh full refund, ya 24 ghante mein agar link khula hi nahi. Likho — asli insaan jawab dete hain.
faq.q9: Bhejne ke baad edit kar sakte hain?
faq.a9: Haan — typo theek karo ya photo badlo. Link wahi rehta hai.
